name: InsertRowToExcelWorksheet
label: Insert Row to Excel Worksheet
description: Inserts a new row above the specified row in the provided Excel worksheet.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object where the new row will be inserted.

fields.name: RowIndex
fields.label: Row Index
fields.description: The 1-based index of the row where the new row should be inserted (inserted above this row).
